causal_hypothesis: A Hopper cluster-local producer can avoid the global E4M3 activation interface only if its consumer CTAs remain in the same cluster. Because the pinned real-QKV consumer has 256 output-column CTAs and a portable cluster contains at most eight CTAs, retaining its two-tile critical depth requires at least 16 independent clusters and therefore 16 exact producer copies. That duplicated rowwise reduction, BF16 boundary, amax, quantization, DSM storage, and synchronization should dominate the interface it removes.
stock_control: Corrected exact-order standalone RMSNorm plus dynamic-E4M3 producer, materialized row-major E4M3 [M,5376] and FP32 [M,1] scale, followed by pinned SGLang v0.5.13 fp8_scaled_mm.
candidate_families: one cluster-local producer shared by persistent QKV CTAs
exact producer recomputation per N tile or bounded N-tile group

identities.hardware_scope: NVIDIA H200 SXM, sm_90a, 132 SMs, 50 MiB L2, 4.8 TB/s vendor-reported HBM3e

quality_gate.producer: exact square-sum, normalized-BF16, FP32 scale, and E4M3 activation bytes
quality_gate.fragment_indexing: every distributed row/K-tile fragment reassembles to the materialized bytes
quality_gate.consumer: a later GPU discriminator must consume the complete real layer-0 QKV output and require exact BF16 bytes
quality_gate.signed_zero: positive-zero scale and stock E4M3 zero-byte behavior preserved

performance_slo.component: strictly lower contemporaneous median than corrected materialized producer plus stock fp8_scaled_mm at M=32

budget.cleanup: No bench claim, SSH, CUDA invocation, spend reservation, or provider lifecycle operation.

transfer_limit: This experiment can falsify topology, indexing, traffic, and exact producer-byte contracts. It does not claim H200 latency or CUTLASS FP8FastAccum output order without the named target-H200 call.
